🎓 Education Qualification (Post Wise) for IBPS RRB XIV 2025

  Office Assistant (Multipurpose)
    
      Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized University or its equivalent
      Proficiency in the local language as prescribed by the participating RRB
      Desirable: Knowledge or experience in banking
    
  
  Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager)
    
      Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized University or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate
      Proficiency in the local language as prescribed by the participating RRB
      Desirable: Knowledge or experience in banking

      General Banking Officer: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized University or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and at least 2 years’ experience as an officer in a Bank or Financial Institution
      Agriculture Officer: Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Science/Dairy Science/Fishery Science/Pisciculture/Agricultural Marketing & Cooperation from a recognized University with a minimum of 50% marks and at least 2 years’ experience
      Marketing Officer: MBA in Marketing from a recognized University
      Treasury Manager: Chartered Accountant or MBA in Finance from a recognized University/Institute
      Law Officer: Degree in Law from a recognized University and enrolled as an advocate with Bar Council
      IT Officer: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Information Technology or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks
      CA (Chartered Accountant): Certified Associate (CA) from Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
    
  
  Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager)
    
      Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized University or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and at least 5 years’ experience as an officer in a Bank or Financial Institution
